verdict.rationale: ReadMe supports exporting docs files or PDF from the Branch menu, giving some data portability, but this is limited to documentation content and PDF/file export, not a full open-format export of all underlying data (API metrics, analytics, custom pages, versions, reusable content blocks) in machine-readable open formats like JSON/Markdown source. missing for 10: evidence of exporting all account/project data (metrics, settings, versions) in open formats, confirmation of underlying file format (e.g., raw Markdown vs proprietary), and independent/hands-on confirmation of a full data export and migration path away from ReadMe.
